name: Costa Vida Sweet Pork Enchilada Salad (Grease & Dairy Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Costa Vida Fresh Mexican Grill (Utah County / Salt Lake)
whyItWorks: Layered with a warm flour tortilla, sweet braised pork shoulder, whole beans, cheese, tortilla strips, and heavy creamy dressing. Combining high sugar, legumes, dairy fat, and fried strips triggers gastrocolic spasms.
